chapter: Learning drums and Roy Eldridge's band
title: Getting Roy's drums from Mr. Eldridge; the two Buicks
summary: Without drums, Clarke was given the Eldridge family drums by Roy's father, to Roy's anger, and the band travelled West Virginia in two Buicks.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah.
And --
So, what happened, Roy asked you to go and --
Yeah. Well, you see, it started like he had heard me play with this big band, and I didn't have any drums, so I was very --
You still didn't have any drums.
No, I was just a poor boy. So I went out to his house one day and Mr. Eldridge, he was a wonderful man.
Was he?

So I told Mr. Eldridge, because I had seen drums in Roy's basement, so I said, 'Mr. Eldridge, you know, I've been playing with Roy, and I haven't any drums.' He said, 'What, you have no drums? Take these drums.' Without Roy's knowledge. And when Roy found out that his father had given me the drums he became infuriated with me, you know. He said, 'You got my drums.' And I said, 'Well, Mr. Eldridge gave them to me, and I'm sure Mr. Eldridge bought them.'
(Laughter)
I'm sure you didn't buy them.
I said, 'Mr. Eldridge, he wanted me to have the drums.'
Oh, I can imagine Roy was mad.
So Roy says, 'Okay, then. But don't forget, they're my drums.' I said, 'Okay, Roy.' So we began to travel all over West Virginia in two old Buicks, two top heavy Buicks.
Who had the Buicks?
Roy.
Who?
Roy. Roy's old Buicks.
Oh, he got himself enough change to buy Buicks?
Well, his father was very successful. What was his father, now? His father was, let's see -- he was in construction or something like that.
Yeah.
But his father was very wealthy.
Yeah.
You know?
And of course I guess he was backing Roy, wanted to see Roy do things.
Yeah. He backed -- yeah, he was behind Roy and Joe all the way.
Yeah. Were there any other brothers?
No.
Just those two boys?
I think there was a sister. Yeah, there
was a sister.
Yeah.
